text: A clear voice makes each word easy to hear. Take your time, finish each sound, and leave a short pause before the next word. The bright light fell across the quiet room.
description: An adult male American English instructor with a clear natural middle-low register. Plain, patient and precise speech with crisp but natural consonants and distinct vowel contrasts. Steady restrained intonation and a slightly slower educational speaking pace. Clean close studio sound, without a dramatic bass voice, breathiness, vocal fry, excessive enthusiasm or singing.
